text: Deportivo Alavés' Asian main sponsor was rebranded, per a 30 June 2025 club announcement, to 'MK TIYU NEWS' / 'MK体育NEWS' (mktynews.com), a sports-news portal; the sponsor's own corporate ownership could not be reliably pinned down.

source.name: Deportivo Alaves official club news on the sponsor rebrand; mktynews.com
source.quote: The Asian company, the main sponsor of Deportivo Alavés, will promote the sports news portal MK TIYU News (mktynews.com) as part of its brand promotion plan in international markets.
